title: An n-covector on vectors spanned by an orthonormal n-frame is det(⟨τᵢ, bⱼ⟩) times its value on the frame
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let τ = (τ₁, …, τₙ) (indexed by Fin n) be an orthonormal family in ℝᴾ = Euclid P and let b = (b₁, …, bₙ) be a family in ℝᴾ with bⱼ ∈ span{τ₁, …, τₙ} for every j. Then for every n-covector α of ℝᴾ (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form), α(b₁, …, bₙ) = det(𝒜)·α(τ₁, …, τₙ), where 𝒜 is the n×n real matrix 𝒜ᵢⱼ := ⟨τᵢ, bⱼ⟩ (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (τ i) (b j)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ b : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ j, b j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ)) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α b = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (τ i) (b j)).det * α τ
